elements.label: Figure 3.1
elements.title: Elements of a quality infrastructure system
elements.content:
Products, organizations, and people -> Standardization: Provides technical specifications
Standardization -> Accreditation: Specifies assessment methods
Standardization -> Metrology: Defines units
Metrology -> Accreditation: Provides reference standards, materials, and calibration
Standardization -> Conformity assessment: Demonstrates conformity with specifications
Accreditation -> Conformity assessment: Attests to technical competence
Conformity assessment -> Products, organizations, and people: Monitors compliance with legislation and imposes sanctions
Market surveillance (for regulated areas) -> Products, organizations, and people: Monitors compliance with legislation and imposes sanctions
Outcomes: Quality, Health and safety, Environmental protection, Security, Market access, Innovation
